evals.prompt: plan my next two weeks of LinkedIn and X content — I post about 3 times a week
evals.expected_output: A markdown table (Date | Platform | Pillar | Format | Working title / hook | Status) covering two weeks, volume at or under the stated cadence, with reactive slack and real hooks.
assertions: Output is a markdown table with the columns Date, Platform, Pillar, Format, Working title / hook, Status
Total posts per platform per week do not exceed the stated cadence
At least two slots are marked 'reactive'
Every non-reactive slot has a concrete hook, not a topic label

evals.prompt: what should I post this month?
evals.expected_output: The skill asks for pillars, platforms, and honest cadence (or reads social-context.md), then returns a realistic dated plan rather than an unrealistic daily firehose.
assertions: Establishes cadence and pillars before planning
Does not exceed a realistic sustainable cadence
